package httpx

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestA(t *testing.T) {
	if Do(1) != 2 {
		t.Errorf("a")
	}
}

func TestB(t *testing.T) {
	got := Do(2)
	if got != 3 {
		t.Errorf("b: %d", got)
	}
	if got < 0 {
		t.Errorf("negative")
	}
}

func TestC(t *testing.T) {
	if strings.ToLower(Name()) != "x" {
		t.Errorf("c")
	}
}
